Executive summary

Civic Water Engineering must select a pump module for the water-reclamation transfer loop. All four candidates clear the policy gates of quality index at least 80 and raw defects at most 5 on the shared acceptance-run basis. Measured energy per run: P2 12 kWh, P3 52, P1 56, P4 58. P2 therefore wins the lowest-energy rule, 40 kWh ahead of runner-up P3. P2 also carries the top quality index, 97, with a single recorded defect.
